description: Save a query as a feed (needs a key). Sources, kinds and tags narrow; q is a text match; upcoming keeps only future-dated items.

bbox.description: west,south,east,north; west > east crosses the antimeridian

description.description: One line about the feed (optional), e.g. Every Rust crate release

enrichers.description: Enricher names to show (see list_enrichers), e.g. ["youtube"]; omit for the collection defaults

name.description: Display name for the feed, e.g. Rust releases

public.description: Listed publicly, true or false, default true

q.description: Text the items must match (optional), e.g. tokio

sort.description: Result order. distance (needs lat and long) puts the nearest first, e.g. "distance"; anything else keeps newest first

upcoming.description: true keeps only items dated in the future, e.g. true; default false

name: create_feed
